mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task_result (task_id, storage_key, mime_type, size_bytes, width, height, created_at) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{storageKey}, #{mimeType}, #{sizeBytes}, #{width}, #{height}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT task_id AS taskId, storage_key AS storageKey, mime_type AS mimeType, size_bytes AS sizeBytes, width, height, created_at AS createdAt FROM task_result WHERE task_id = #{taskId}
